content.title: Your first day on Salesmessage
content.summary: Five steps take you from your invite to your first real conversation in about 20 minutes. Your organization is already registered and approved with the carriers, so everything here is just your own setup.

sections.heading: 1. Accept your invite
sections.body: Open the invitation email from Salesmessage, click the link, and set your password.

rows.label: Done when
rows.value: You're logged in and can see your workspace and inbox.

sections.heading: 2. Get your contacts in
sections.body: Add one contact by hand, or import your list. You can't text anyone until someone's in here. This is the step people most often skip and then get stuck on.
bullets: Working in HubSpot? Contacts arrive as they're used, not all at once.
They come across when searched for, opened in the panel, or run through a workflow.
Need your list brought over in bulk? Ask your admin.

rows.label: Done when
rows.value: At least one person you plan to text is in your contacts.

sections.heading: 3. Send your first text
sections.body: Pick a contact, write something real rather than a test, and send.

sections.heading: 4. Get a reply and respond
sections.body: Ask a colleague to text your Salesmessage number, then reply from your inbox. This is the real test: it proves messages reach you as well as leave you.

rows.label: Done when
rows.value: You received an inbound message, got notified, and replied.

sidebar.heading: At a glance
sidebar.callout_text: A phone number in your CRM isn't permission to text. Only message people who agreed to hear from you.

sections.heading: 5. Set up wherever you work
sections.body: Install the mobile app so you're reachable away from your desk, and the Chrome extension if you text from your browser.

rows.label: Done when
rows.value: You see the same conversations everywhere you work.

sections.heading: Working in HubSpot?
sections.body: Two things only you can do in your own HubSpot account:

rows.label: App Card
rows.value: Add it in your HubSpot settings. It won't appear on contact records until you do.

rows.label: User mapping
rows.value: Check that your HubSpot user is mapped to your Salesmessage user.

rows.label: Unmapped users
rows.value: Can't send. Your admin can map you.

sections.heading: If something doesn't work
sections.body: Quick checks before you ask for help:

rows.label: Message didn't deliver
rows.value: Usually the number or content. Send your admin the contact and time.

rows.label: No inbound notification
rows.value: Check your notification settings, then your phone's. Still nothing? Tell your admin.

rows.label: No App Card in HubSpot
rows.value: Add it yourself in HubSpot settings. There but won't send? You're not mapped.

sidebar.heading: Getting help
sidebar.callout_text: A single emoji or a curly quote pasted from Word drops a credit from 160 characters to 70 and doubles the cost.

cta.headline: Stuck on any of this?
cta.text: Ask your account admin first; most of it they can fix in a minute.
